scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol palette with rank-encoded node colors, clean search UI with inline match count, and confident whitespace, though the bottom half of the viewport sits empty with the tree occupying only the top third.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout with no quantitative scales means most honesty checks are N/A; color encodes categorical rank correctly, circle radius encodes structural state (not data magnitude), and SVG dimensions plus descendant counts are fully data-driven — only minor concern is the non-unique key function (`name + depth`) that could corrupt transitions if duplicate names appeared at the same depth.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() before new transitions means rapid clicks or search input (200ms debounce vs 500ms transition) can cause mid-flight conflicts; no brush/zoom so update storm, stale scale, and infinite loop risks are absent; pointer events correctly unify mouse/touch.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Clean progressive disclosure with collapsed-by-default depth management keeps working memory load low; 6-color rank legend is within perceptual limits and the search+highlight path mechanism handles large tree navigation without overwhelming the viewer.
